answer: Use vouching chains with decaying trust: a new agent can only transact after established peers stake part of their own reputation on it, like boats tying up at a jetty, where each mooring line is a public, revocable endorsement. If the newcomer turns out to be fake, every voucher loses a slice of standing, so launching a tide of sock puppets means first buying trust from real agents. Endorsements fade unless renewed through honest work, and an opal-clear audit trail shows who vouched for whom, making bulk Sybil creation expensive, slow, and traceable.
